networks.name: no_envy
networks.description: I can fill in this rent sheet with you, work out a split where nobody wants to swap rooms, and explain it. The page does the arithmetic, not the AI.
sample_queries: Who gets which room on this sheet, and what does each person pay?
We are three housemates paying 2400 a month for a big room, a middle room and a small room. Set up the sheet for us.
What would change if the first person valued the first room 100 lower and the second room 100 higher?
Why is this split fair? Explain it simply.
Our lease says the tenants are jointly and severally liable. Can you ask Plainly what that means?
Can you collect the rent from my housemates each month?

peer_policy.note: Local agents and page-local actions, plus the partner sites in allowed_peers, which are called only after the visitor agrees on a card.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
